purpose: Apply the V26 discovery hierarchy to an untested canonical size mechanism: freeze a broad, industry-neutral pre-2021 circulating-size mother, render every six-month-before/six-month-after chart, review every event, and compress only repeated causal distinctions before aggregation.
economic_question: Within the same PIT industry, do the smallest versus largest causally known circulating-market-value firms express distinct risk-on continuation or defensive behavior, and does a causal broad-market state determine which side has usable absolute long opportunity?

semantic_boundary.accepted_coordinate: circulating_market_value_cny = raw completed close * causally available circulating_shares
semantic_boundary.reason_for_use: MKT-STYLE-DATA-001 already passed exact announcement/effective-date, turnover-unit, availability, population, and identity gates for this narrow coordinate; no small-size premium or strategy usefulness has yet been tested.

mother_identity.signal_clock: the first completed Friday exchange session in each calendar month; a month without a Friday session produces no signal
mother_identity.universe: non-ST Main Board and ChiNext rows passing CY-006 hard/bar/float/corporate-action/market-rule/historical-identity/current-tradability gates, with available_at <= decision_at, positive raw close/circulating shares/volume/amount, nonblocking zero current corporate actions, valid PIT industry, and a matching accepted coordinate-daily row
mother_identity.history: exactly 60 prior global exchange sessions with complete accepted same-lineage coordinate rows; missing or invalid history fails closed

lanes.SMALL_CIRCULATING_SIZE: the eligible stock with minimum current circulating_market_value_cny inside each PIT industry/date
lanes.LARGE_CIRCULATING_SIZE: the eligible stock with maximum current circulating_market_value_cny inside each PIT industry/date

mother_identity.tie_break: larger current amount, then lexical symbol
mother_identity.cooldown: after a stock is selected in either lane, suppress every later event for that stock during the next 60 global exchange-session indices

chart_and_label_plan.chart_window: 126 global exchange sessions before through 126 after the mother signal
chart_and_label_plan.entry_label: first legal non-upper-limit open in signal+1 through signal+3; never same-session
chart_and_label_plan.review_order: all chronological sheets first; outcome groups only challenge proposed distinctions

development_gate_after_rule_freeze.validation_open: 2022-2024 only after every development gate passes

not_reused: V26 true-gap identity or corridor thresholds
Low Idio, Low Skewness, or Low Vol-of-Vol
